lines.en: When it comes to friendship,
Sam Puckett will always have your back.
But sometimes, she can be a little rough around the edges.
Here are five reasons Sam is the best and worst friend.
You know, anybody but me would punch you right in the head.
Which is why you are my best friend.
Good to know.
Now, why are you mine?
The first reason she makes a good friend
is that her loyalty runs deep.
When it comes to boys, Sam is the ultimate wingman for Carly.
Okay, it's still not like me to get all crazy
about a hot guy like Jake Crandall.
- But? - But oh my God, he's so hot,
I want to bake cookies on him.
I'd eat those cookies.
If you like him so much, go say hi to him.
What? You can't just say hi to a guy like Jake Crandall.
What if he says hi back? Then what do I say?
Just say, um, sorry I hit you in the head with an apple.
Why would I ask?
Ow.
Carly did it!
And she is not afraid to let her aggressive side out
to protect her BFFs.
Sam?
Yeah?
Rip her head off.
Rip my head off?
I'd love to see her try it.
Speaking of aggressive.
Ah! Let me go!
- Say you're sorry. - I'm sorry.
And what are you sorry for?
For saying you're aggressive.
Her tough exterior can lead to some really savage moments.
- Do that again! - You're not the boss of me.
Can we lower the microphone a little bit?
A little lower, a little lower.
And Sam would never pass up the chance to make fun of Freddy.
Cool. I give glasses with feet, girl, an eight.
- I give her a nine. - Seven.
But I give Freddy a negative two.
- For what? - Just for being you.
You know, they say when a girl constantly rips on a guy,
it really just means she has a crush on him.
Yeah, but I wasn't ripping on a guy, I was ripping on you.
Which often puts a strain on their friendship.
Wow. This is amazing.
Someone finally friended you?
Control, Freddy. Bad thoughts lead to bad actions.
Sam's greatest quality is her confidence,
making her super fun to hang out with.
She's always willing to be silly,
especially when it comes to skits on iCarly.
Just give me some soup!
I ain't gonna give you no soup!
Just give me some soup!
I ain't gonna give you no soup!
Just give me some soup!
I ain't gonna give you no soup!
- Scene. - Thank you.
There will never be a dull moment whenever Sam is around.
I'll down the lobby downstairs.
Main lobby.
- Aaaaaaah! - Aaaaaaah! - Aaaaaaah!
Although she may be loyal, she's often selfish.
Can I have that sandwich?
No way, get your own.
Ow!
During Sam and Carly's five-year friend anniversary,
she traded the homemade t-shirt Carly made for her
for cuttlefish tickets.
I can't believe you!
Look, make me another shirt if you want to
after we go to the cuttlefish concert.
I'm not going to the concert with you.
Oh, now you're being ridiculous.
Better than being a gift-giver-awayer.
Just forget it.
Fine, don't go to the concert.
- I won't! - I don't even care.
I care way less than you care.
You don't know how much I don't care.
Oh, all you ever think about is ham.
I'd rather have a shirt made of ham.
I can't believe you just gave it away.
I can't believe we're having this stupid conversation.
- Just don't talk to me! - I'm not talking to you!
- By saying you're talking to me, you are talking to me! - It is not!
- So don't talk to me! - Don't talk to me!
- Bye! - Bye!
She even went to the concert without Carly.
Oh, man, Sam, thank you so much for taking me
to the cuttlefish concert.
It was the most awesome concert ever.
Remember at the end when they played Rock Me, Love Me,
and we held up our cell phones to illuminate the darkness?
Whoa, I have to go to algebra class?
Fine!
You went to the concert?
And you took Tureen?
Oh, no.
You refused to go.
I wasn't just going to waste the tickets.
You got those for us.
We were so close.
You said you weren't going to come right
before you called me a gift-giver-awayer.
I can't believe I almost made up with you.
Back at you.
But after some painful hair-pulling,
the two were able to make up.
I'm sorry.
I'm sorry.
It's no secret that she loves to eat.
I loves me the cold chili.
The final reason that Sam makes a good friend is that she will always
have yummy snacks if you get hungry while hanging out.
- Ham? - Uh-huh.
- Extra ham? - Uh-huh.
- Is that turkey bacon? - Uh-huh.
Is that turkey bacon?
A little army?
I'm going to need another fat bag.
Just watch out, because she may not be willing to share.
Do you have any pudding cups?
Just one, and I already promised Freddy he could have it after the show.
Even with all her faults, Sam is definitely a great friend to have.
Oh, Sam.
Hey!
Who stopped the elevator?
Get out!
